scripts.test:runtime: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix src/core run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/security/runtime-isolation.test.cjs scripts/security/runtime-models.test.cjs scripts/security/runtime-capabilities.test.cjs
scripts.test:runtime:integration: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix src/core run build && node scripts/security/runtime-postgres.test.cjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:front && node dist/server.js
scripts.apps:dev: concurrently -k -n core,ide,auth -c blue,green,magenta "npm run core:dev" "npm run ide:dev" "npm run auth:dev"
scripts.docs:start: npm run docs:generate && npm --prefix docs/site run start
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && npm --prefix docs/site run build
scripts.docker:build:local: npm run docker:prepare && docker compose build
scripts.podman:build:local: npm run docker:prepare && podman compose build
scripts.db:status: npm run build:shared && node src/packages/shared/dist/database/cli.js status
scripts.db:plan: npm run build:shared && node src/packages/shared/dist/database/cli.js plan
scripts.db:diff: npm run build:shared && node src/packages/shared/dist/database/cli.js diff
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && node src/packages/shared/dist/database/cli.js migrate
scripts.db:adopt: npm run build:shared && node src/packages/shared/dist/database/cli.js adopt
scripts.test:installation: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix src/core run build && node scripts/release/installation-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:container: npm run docker:prepare -- core && node scripts/release/container-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:auth: npm --prefix src/auth run build:server && node --test scripts/security/auth-oauth.test.cjs
